Social Listening: Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e análise de tendências (Stilingue, Buzzmonitor ou similares). - MLOps: Vivência na implementação de pipelines de automação para modelos de Machine Learning. - Análise de Grafos: Conhecimento em análise de redes para mapear conexões entre comunidades e influenciadores. - Publicidade: Experiência prévia em agências de publicidade, veículos de mídia ou AdTechs.Informações adicionais- Vale Refeição no cartão iFood; - Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

About PiecePiece is a holding company that acquires vertical software/AI businesses and scales them through creator-powered distribution. We believe the next Latin American giants will emerge at the intersection of AI and creator economy — software brings technology, recurring revenue, and LTV;  creators bring audience, trust, and distribution. Piece brings them together.Our edge is a proprietary creator-focused distribution engine that uses AI to automate growth across our vertical software portfolio — social media, sales funnels, content, and creator operations. Every vertical we add makes the machine smarter, compounding proprietary data on what works in creator-led distribution for AI/Software. Our goal is to hit US$10M ARR in 2026.We're building Piece to be a home for some of the most exceptional people in the world. Talent density is non-negotiable, the bar is unreasonably high, and we expect excellence in everything we ship. Our ambition is to put Brazil on the map as a global protagonist in growth and distribution.The RoleWe're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to be the technical pillar of the product at the first and main company in our portfolio — someone who combines technical depth with product sense, and who will own the architecture, evolution, and operation of its entire backend and AI infrastructure.You'll be hands-on building and scaling the systems that orchestrate our agents, process messages in real time, and sustain the platform's accelerated growth. This isn't a maintenance role — it's a building role.If you enjoy solving complex problems in distributed systems, have a genuine interest in applied AI, and want to build something that's reshaping how the Brazilian legal market operates, this is the place. You'll join as part of our founding team, with competitive compensation and meaningful equity through stock options.What you'll doBackend architecture and evolution- Design and evolve the microservices that power the platform, with a focus on scalability and maintainability - Make technical decisions autonomously — database modeling, API design, stack choices - Raise the team's technical bar through code review and mentorshipAI agents and LLMs- Build and evolve our agent pipelines: orchestration, tool calling, dynamic workflows, and intelligent routing - Optimize cost and latency of LLM calls without compromising quality - Evolve our RAG, document processing, and voice synthesis featuresIntegrations and operations- Ensure reliability of asynchronous message flows and external integrations - Build new integrations as the product evolves - Maintain operational stability in a multi-tenant system with paying customersQuality and observability- Ensure end-to-end traceability across synchronous and asynchronous flows - Structure operational metrics and maintain visibility over agent behavior in production - Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they become incidentsWhat we expect from youBackend & Systems- Proficiency with Node.Js + TypeScript in high-throughput production systems — including API design, modular architecture, and long-term maintainability decisions - Strong grasp of event-driven and asynchronous architectures: message queues, pub/sub patterns, idempotency, retry logic, and failure isolation in distributed systems - Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS backends: data isolation strategies, per-tenant configuration, and operational complexity at scale - Solid database modeling — relational (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and NoSQL (document modeling, consistency trade-offs) — and ability to choose the right store for the problem - Hands-on cloud experience (GCP preferred): Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore/Cloud SQL, IAM, and observability toolingAI & Agent Systems- Experience building LLM-powered pipelines in production — not just calling APIs, but thinking through orchestration, context management, fallback behavior, and output reliability - Understanding of agent architectures: tool calling, multi-step reasoning, routing logic, state management across turns, and how to make agents predictable in real-world conditions - Practical knowledge of RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding selection, retrieval quality, and reranking — and awareness of where RAG breaks down - Cost and latency awareness in LLM usage: prompt engineering for efficiency, model selection trade-offs, caching strategies, and when not to use an LLM - Familiarity with evaluation and observability for AI systems: how to measure agent quality, detect regressions, and maintain visibility over non-deterministic behavior in productionProduct & Technical Judgment- Ability to reason about product trade-offs, not just technical ones — understands what to build, what to cut, and why - Comfortable operating with ambiguity: capable of going from a fuzzy problem to a concrete technical proposal without needing a fully-specced ticket - Has opinions about prioritization and isn't just an executor — questions requirements upstream and thinks about user and business impact before writing the first line of code - Uses AI tools natively in the development workflow (coding assistants, automated testing, code review, documentation) and stays current with the evolving tooling landscape. Understands that development velocity is a competitive advantage, not just an output metricQuality & Operational Maturity- Ability to instrument distributed systems end-to-end: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLO thinking - Experience operating asynchronous flows with real customers: understanding of what breaks silently and how to catch it before they do - Comfort with ambiguity — able to define the right technical approach when the problem itself is still being figured outNice to have- Python for ML/data pipelines or LLM experimentation - Go for latency-critical or high-throughput services - Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RLHF, or systematic model evaluation - Background in regulated or compliance-heavy domains (legaltech, fintech)What we offer- Founding team seat — real ownership of what gets built and how - Competitive compensation - Meaningful stock options - On-site environment with high talent density and direct exposure to foundersDetails- Work model: On-site (São Paulo or São José dos Campos) - Availability: Full-time - Contract: PJ

title: Veeva Support Analyst
description:

description:

Remote Human Resources and Investigation ASSISTANT and Human Resources and Investigation SPECIALIST Positions Do you live inBRAZILand have advanced professional communication skills in English, both orally and in writing? Do you love to read, write, and analyze things? Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker? Can you type both fast and accurately? Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting? Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who gets excited about the pursuit of solving a mystery in the context of employee discrimination/harassment complaint investigations? Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!About California Labor Solutions California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.What are Workplace (Employee Complaint) Investigations? In the U.S., when an employee files a complaint about harassment, discrimination, or retaliation, the organization is legally obligated to investigate it. Some are handled internally, and others require an external investigator to ensure impartiality... that's where CLS comes in! Assistants support the Investigator during the investigation process, including interviews with the employee who filed the complaint, relevant witnesses, and the accused, taking interview notes, and gathering the evidence. Then, we analyze all the testimonies and evidence and reach a factual finding of whether the alleged conduct happened and, if so, whether it violated any of the company's policies.We are hiring for either an HR & Investigation Assistant OR an HR & Investigation Specialist.Amazing Compensation, Benefits, and Bonuses: Compensation:HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now):The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $7,000 BRL. This includes benefits which are: · Gym membership support: $105 BRL · Private health insurance support: $265 BRL · Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRLStarting monthly base compensation depends on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications.Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.As an HR & Investigation Assistant, you may become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Specialist position after a minimum of 12 months, during which time advanced core competencies required to perform the work are established.HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now):The total monthly compensation range is $7,000 BRL - $11,000 BRL. The total compensation amount includes benefits which are: · Gym membership support: $105 BRL · Private health insurance support: $265 BRL · Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRLStarting monthly compensation will be between $7,000 BRL to $8,500 BRL depending on your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, possession of both required and preferred qualifications and your performance on the assessments in the hiring process.Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position.Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities - Such as:·High-performance bonus:When you perform investigations work, every investigation that you complete from start to finish according to CLS protocols and without major errors, you will receive a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (person co-leading the project and performing the final review.) When you become a "CLS Certified Investigator's Assistant" (which is usually within the first 3 to 6 months of joining CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.Operations Schedule from Your Designated Home Office Join an enthusiastic team and make a real difference in this full-time role. Core hours of operation are 6 am - 4 pm PST / 7 am - 5 pm PDT, California/USA, Monday - Friday, and the potential for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.Minimum Education/Experience RequirementsHuman Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT: Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills arerequired. A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) isrequired.(Work experience in an internship does not count towards the 2-year requirement). A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office isrequired. A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field isrequired.A Master's Degree is preferred. Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues ispreferred. 3 or more years of experience working in a full-time professional HR-related job in English, which includes daily communication and writing using advanced professional English skills, ispreferred.Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST: Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills arerequired. At least 5 years of full-time professional work experience in English (in any field) isrequired. Internships do not count. At least 3 of those 5 years must be in full-time HR positions where you frequently wrote professional documents in English. A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office isrequired. Experience supervising 3 or more employees for at least 1 year isrequired. Experience drafting employee disciplinary letters and conducting investigations of workplace issues ispreferred. A Professional Bachelor's Degree in any field isrequired.A Master's Degree ispreferred.GROW at CLS! You will receive a performance evaluation and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL every 6 months. The amount of your compensation increase depends on your performance and will continue to increase every 6-months until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION MANAGER (Promotional only):The total monthly compensation range is $16,800 BRL to $27,000 BRL (this includes benefits). title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Campaign Director em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration:1 yearEmployment type:Independent contractor agreement Location:Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to:Senior Director Salary:Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location Application closing date:June 1st 9am BSTHow to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.Who we're looking for We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience.How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status. Responsibilities Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.Js and Node.Js Develop and implement highly responsive UI components Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications Monitor and improve end-to-end performance Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems  Required Experience Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.Js, Node.Js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software A focus on customer value delivery Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake  Desired Experience University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field  Additional Information Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays Start: ASAP  Core Client Values The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture. Trust: We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable. Health: We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team. Respect: We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk. Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners. Accountability: We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do. Diversity: We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger. The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We're a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world's most forward-thinking brands. You'll work closely with project managers, UX strategists, and developers throughout the full project lifecycle — from early strategy through final execution — while managing multiple projects at a time. This role is client-facing: you'll design systems, shape web content strategies, present work, lead design conversations, and collaborate across the team to deliver cohesive, high-quality web experiences. You'll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling.What You'll Do ● Own the creative process. Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality. ● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites. ● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability. ● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution. ● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project. ● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence. ● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each. ● Contribute to a collaborative team culture — sharing feedback, flagging blockers early, and keeping work moving. ● Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life. ● Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality. ● Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects.What We're Looking For ● 4+ years of web design experience, ideally within an agency setting. Ideally, with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities. ● Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web projects with clear UX and visual thinking, including strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking alongside visual craft. ● Comfortable working across a full project team — PMs, strategists, and developers — in a structured, waterfall workflow. ● Proven ability to lead client conversations, present creative directions, and navigate feedback professionally with clarity and confidence. ● Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences. ● Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles. ● High proficiency in Figma required.;  Webflow and Adobe Creative Suite a plus. ● Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred. ● Proactive and organized — capable of managing multiple projects and taking initiative without waiting to be directed. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment.Why Join BX Studio? ● Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands. ● Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities. ● Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design. ● Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

Familiaridade com redes sociais para atendimento ao cliente também via mensagens.   Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário do comércio, em lojas de shopping ou de rua.   Vontade de aprender em capacitações gratuitas para acelerar seu aprendizado em turismo. description:

Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious CompoundsTMWe are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels.At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy.Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you.What You Will Be Responsible For: Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teamsWhat We Are Looking For: 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design. A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered. Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad. Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste. Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships. Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plusSuccess Roadmap:In 30 Days, You'll: Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages. Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences. Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed. Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts. In 60 Days, You'll: Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent. Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages. Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts. Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process In 90 Days, You'll: Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages. Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage. Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.By Your One-Year Anniversary: You will have helped establish Lucyd's post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to: Faster landing page creation and iteration Higher-quality post-click experiences Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the clickApply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

O Scrum Master é o líder servidor responsável por estabelecer e sustentar o Scrum conforme definido no Guia do Scrum, além de integrar práticas de Kanban e Lean para otimizar o fluxo de entrega. Em um contexto de mineração, ele atua como o elo de eficiência entre as equipes de desenvolvimento e os desafios operacionais de campo, garantindo que o time supere impedimentos técnicos e culturais na integração de sistemas industriais.Responsabilidades Principais Facilitação e Coach Ágil:Conduzir ritos (Daily, Planning, Review e Retrospective) garantindo o foco em resultados e a melhoria contínua do Time de Desenvolvimento. Otimização do Fluxo (Lean/Kanban):Aplicar métricas de fluxo (Lead Time, Cycle Time e Throughput) para identificar desperdícios e aumentar a previsibilidade das entregas. Apoio ao Product Owner:Auxiliar o PO na organização do backlog e na compreensão da agilidade técnica necessária para produtos voltados à operação mineira. Gestão de Mudanças e Cultura:Promover a mentalidade ágil em ambientes tradicionalmente rígidos, facilitando a colaboração entre engenheiros de automação e desenvolvedores de software. Proteção do Time:Blindar a equipe de interferências externas durante a Sprint, garantindo o foco nos compromissos assumidos.Esperamos que você tenha: Formação Superior em Tecnologia. Vivência sólida como Scrum Master em projetos de tecnologia aplicada à indústria ou mineração (ex: Sistemas de Despacho, Automação de Ativos, Dashboards de Operação). Domínio profundo dos frameworks Scrum e Kanban. Conhecimento em princípios Lean Manufacturing/Lean IT (identificação de desperdícios e VSM). Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de ciclo de vida de aplicação (Azure DevOps ou Jira). Noções de integração TI/TO: Entendimento básico de protocolos industriais, sistemas MES e arquiteturas de nuvem para suporte à Indústria 4.0. Certificações (Essenciais): PSM I ou II (Professional Scrum Master) ou CSM (Certified Scrum Master). PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:      Quarterly package review     - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses     - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items     - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:     The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:     Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:      Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Gerente De Vendas
description:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Vendas Sênior com experiência relevante na indústria de componentes eletrônicos para integrar a equipe da Win Source. O candidato ideal será responsável por desenvolver contas, realizar o acompanhamento de consultas e manter relacionamentos de longo prazo. Esta posição é fundamental para aprimorar o desempenho de vendas da empresa e a satisfação do cliente.Sobre a Win Source:A Win Source é uma distribuidora líder de componentes eletrônicos, comprometida em oferecer serviços de excelência e soluções inovadoras para clientes em todo o mundo. Nossa missão é apoiar o avanço tecnológico de nossos clientes, garantindo a disponibilidade de componentes de alta qualidade.Site da empresa: win-source.NetConteúdo do Trabalho: (Jornada de trabalho de 5 dias, 8 horas diárias) 1. Desenvolver clientes, realizar acompanhamento (follow-up), identificar e classificar consultas de clientes, e executar a manutenção contínua desses contatos. 2. Elaborar cotações para produtos solicitados pelos clientes, acompanhar a demanda dos clientes por produtos, conduzir negociações comerciais, concluir pedidos e monitorar a entrega dos produtos para garantir a qualidade, quantidade, prazo de entrega e modalidade de transporte, conforme os requisitos do cliente. 3. Desenvolver estrategicamente seu território de vendas por meio da aquisição planejada e sistemática de novos clientes, mantendo comunicação e coordenação constantes com os departamentos internos de atendimento e técnico. 4. Manter regularmente um bom serviço de pós-venda e bons relacionamentos com os clientes, via e-mail e telefone, preservando parcerias de cooperação de longo prazo. 5. Motivar e liderar a equipe de vendas, definir objetivos claros, monitorar a evolução do desempenho e fornecer os treinamentos e recursos necessários. 6. Realizar viagens de negócios locais para visitar clientes e participar de diversas feiras e exposições do setor.Perspectivas de Carreira: Engenheiro de Vendas Sênior → Líder de Equipe Comercial → Gerente Regional → Diretor de VendasSistema Remuneratório: Salário base + Comissão + Bônus por Desempenho + Bônus por Projetos + Bônus de Final de AnoRequisitos para a Vaga: 1. Disponibilidade para atuar em escritórios nacionais em diversas partes do mundo. Os países com vagas abertas incluem: Estados Unidos, Japão, Reino Unido, Canadá, Alemanha, Itália, Austrália, Dinamarca, Espanha, França, Coreia do Sul, Brasil e Malásia. (É exigido residir e trabalhar localmente, além de possuir planos de desenvolvimento de longo prazo na região). 2. Possuir conhecimento específico sobre componentes eletrônicos ou sobre a indústria eletrônica, compreendendo as tendências de mercado e as necessidades dos clientes. 3. Experiência na indústria de distribuição de componentes eletrônicos é um diferencial.Benefícios: 1. Desfrutar de feriados nacionais oficiais e benefícios festivos. 2. Os funcionários efetivos terão direito a gratificações por tempo de serviço, férias anuais remuneradas (de até 10 dias) e licença-maternidade remunerada. 3. A empresa organiza viagens anualmente e promove outras atividades periodicamente. 4. Convidamos regularmente profissionais de destaque do setor para treinamentos e aprendizado, além de realizarmos sessões de compartilhamento de experiências de negócios. 5. A empresa participa regularmente de feiras internacionais de eletrônicos todos os anos (nos Estados Unidos, Alemanha, Vietnã e Brasil). 6. Oferecemos treinamento remunerado abrangente, incluindo capacitação inicial sobre produtos, métodos comerciais e raciocínio estratégico, organizado em etapas para garantir uma formação sistemática, com orientação individual personalizada (mentoria 1 a 1). 7. O período de experiência inclui o recebimento de comissões, e há dois dias de folga aos finais de semana.Requisitos e Habilidades: 1. Graduação (nível superior) ou formação acadêmica superior;  a área de formação é flexível (preferência para cursos em Engenharia Eletrônica ou Marketing). 2. Boas habilidades de escuta, fala, leitura e escrita;  proficiência no uso do idioma inglês para comunicação e negociação com clientes. 3. Boas habilidades de comunicação, coordenação e execução;  capacidade de resposta rápida e perspicaz;  forte senso de responsabilidade. 4. Experiência em técnicas e estratégias de vendas, incluindo habilidades de apresentação e negociação. 5. Forte capacidade de aprendizado e espírito de busca por aprendizado contínuo. 6. Aspiração em atuar e paixão pelo setor de comércio exterior e e-commerce. 7. Bom espírito de equipe.

description:

High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive information. Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships at all levels. Proactive mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities. Flexibility and adaptability to shifting priorities and work demands. Industry/sector knowledge is a plus. About Kerry Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM Location : Campinas, Brazil Role Overview We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments. This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability. Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2. Key Responsibilities Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior. Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related. Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools. Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts. Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis. Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred. Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations. Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required. Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination. Preferred Qualifications Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management. Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900, or similar are preferred but not mandatory. Soft Skills Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability. description:

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨ Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura): Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades: 1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado) Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document) Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você) Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. PARA ISSO, OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ TRABALHAR CONOSCO: 01) Salário: A combinar (Enviar pretensão salarial) 02 Segunda a Sexta 03) Horário: 08h às 17h 04) Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP 05) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) 06) Regime de contratação: CLT 07) Plano de carreira 08) Cesta básica R$250,00 09) Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia 10) Vale transporte c/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 11) Benefícios de VR, Cesta e Auxilio combustível, pagos através de um cartão unificado e flexível, operadora pela Sólides, para utilização na modalidade de crédito, bandeira Mastercard e que é aceito em uma infinidade de estabelecimentos 12) Convênio Farmácia,que conta com ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento 13) Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês 14) Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna 15) Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping 16) Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido, pago mensalmente diretamente à administração Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect featuresas single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving. How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty. What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;  quality comes from you. To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Technical Product Owner em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication. The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams. The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience. The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams. Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement. Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment. Be fully aligned with our core values: Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have. Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday. Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day. Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family. By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process. WHAT WE OFFER Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing. Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story. Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone. Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all. Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them. An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued. OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil! Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares! Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história. Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível. *Esta não é uma vaga CLT* O que oferecemos? Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados. Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como consultor Funcional, você atuará como Key User funcional especializado em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud, sendo a ponte entre o time comercial (vendas e atendimento) e as áreas técnicas de TI. Seu principal objetivo é garantir a correta utilização da plataforma, aumentar a produtividade dos usuários, traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais e apoiar a evolução contínua dos processos de CRM, sempre com foco na experiência do cliente e na eficiência operacional. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar usuários comerciais no uso diário do Salesforce, tirando dúvidas, resolvendo problemas de navegação e promovendo boas práticas. Executar atividades operacionais relacionadas a processos de vendas (ex.: criação e acompanhamento de oportunidades, leads, contratos) e atendimento (casos, resolução de solicitações). Detalhar requisitos de negócio junto aos times de vendas, marketing e serviços, transformando demandas em especificações funcionais claras para o time técnico. Validar soluções funcionais antes da liberação em produção, realizando testes de aceitação (UAT) em Sales Cloud e Service Cloud. Homologar novas funcionalidades, fluxos e relatórios, garantindo que atendam aos critérios de negócio e qualidade. Identificar gargalos e melhorias nos processos comerciais e de relacionamento com clientes, propondo ajustes na configuração ou no uso do sistema. Participar de rituais ágeis (daily, review, planning) com o time de CRM, trazendo a visão do negócio. Criar e manter documentação de suporte, manuais e treinamentos para usuários finais. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Experiência prática comprovada em Salesforce Sales Cloud e Service Cloud (mínimo 2 anos atuando como key user, analista funcional ou consultor). Conhecimento sólido de processos de vendas, CRM e atendimento ao cliente (ex.: ciclo de leads, oportunidades, casos, SLAs). Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em requisitos funcionais claros e testáveis. Boa comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir com usuários negócio e times técnicos. Visão de processo e pensamento analítico para identificar melhorias e resolver problemas. Perfil colaborativo, paciente e didático para treinar e apoiar usuários com diferentes níveis de maturidade digital. Você pode se destacar se: Possuir certificações Salesforce, como Salesforce Certified Administrator ou Sales Cloud Consultant / Service Cloud Consultant. Tiver experiência com configurações básicas na plataforma (criação de campos, objetos, perfis, fluxos de aprovação, relatórios e dashboards). Demonstrar conhecimento em ferramentas de automação (Flow, Process Builder) ou integrações (API, middleware). Já tiver atuado em projetos de implantação ou migração de CRM. Apresentar familiaridade com métricas comerciais (funnel de vendas, tempo médio de resposta, NPS, etc.) e capacidade de criar KPIs no Salesforce. Ter experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, utilities, telecom) que exigem governança e rastreabilidade. Mostrar proatividade na gestão de mudanças e no treinamento de novos usuários (produção de materiais e workshops). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨
